question: A horizontal rod of mass $10 \text{ g}$ and length $10 \text{ cm}$ is placed on two smooth vertical rails. A uniform magnetic field of $1 \text{ T}$ is perpendicular to the rails. If the resistance of the rod is $1 \Omega$, calculate the terminal velocity of the rod as it falls under gravity.
